notes.title: Self Reliance Updates Episode5！
notes.content:
[img]https://pic3.zhimg.com/v2-b7f3e10723c75f542eb555a45795a4ee_b.webp[/img]

Hi there, I am the developer of Self Reliance, MohaElder169。[b]Today is special. It's the one year anniversary of our game, the major update day of our game, and the day of the death of one of the Whistle Blower Doctor due to Coronavirus. [/b]

We announce this update with mixed fdeelings, this time we have updated episode5 with the theme of Pick Up Artists. The following is full update log:

[b]1.Updated Episode5
2.Reprogrammed game's code, boosts running speed and optimizes game size
3.Retranscoded server's video, loads faster and costs less cellular data[/b]

Above is out full announcement of the update. The game is now also available on AppStore and Google Play!

[b]Download the game：
https://www.eroducate.xyz/downloads/[/b]

[b]There is no Supermen descending from the sky, only mortals striving for the crowd. 
Again, to the People of Wuhan, to the People of China, and to the People of The World![/b]

MohaElder169，7/2/2019 11:05 A.M, Shanghai
